Chapter 6985: Please Take Us

Chapter 6985: Please Take Us

“It represents Heavenfall’s power, a celestial immortal, perhaps the greatest of all immortals.” He explained.

“He’s that impressive?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Of course, no one has been able to surpass Heavenfall. Notice the characters in his title, the fall of heaven.” He said.

“It is cool indeed.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, he ambushed the high heaven itself, his power is beyond imagination...” He continued boasting about his knowledge.

Of course, he wasn’t entirely wrong. Only a few in history were stronger than Heavenfall. Thus, he was the greatest in the eyes of an overlord.

However, he didn’t know about other existences, such as Octopus or Hidden Immortal. Heavenfall, on the other hand, was a mythical figure. There were records of him having a paramita body, perhaps the first to do so according to modern records.

Primordial immortals also speculated that he had obtained apex power. The lower realms didn’t have an accurate understanding of this power.

In fact, certain primordial immortals have witnessed it before - Lightness Erasure. All in all, Heavenfall’s strength was well-documented.

Other immortals of similar stature either kept a low profile or have never shown their best form to the public.

Similar rumors spread for Dusk as well, regarding his apex power - High Heaven’s Dusk. Some said he used it during Heaven Pit but still fell to the avatar.

“Then why did he die here?” Li Qiye waited patiently for the man to finish before asking.

“...” He had no response since he only wanted to brag about his knowledge: “It’s not something you can understand, nor should you inquire.”

“Then I will stop asking.” Li Qiye somehow accepted the answer.

“Good boy, good boy.” He was satisfied to see the youth’s sense of propriety: “Don’t worry, fate brought us together today, I will take you to Dusk Realm.”

“You’ve been to Dusk Realm before?” Li Qiye asked.

This was another tough question. The brat was not a good boy at all.

“No, but I know of people who have visited and become powerful immortals.” He coughed and said.

“How powerful?” Li Qiye asked.

“Immensely.” He thought about it and said: “The brat was weak and bullied, pushed to the edge. He jumped in with nowhere else to go and somehow made it to Dusk Realm. After becoming an immortal, he killed ten overlords and three immortals in one battle, it must have been an incredible immortal fortune.”

“And that is what you seek?” Li Qiye stared at the hopeful youth.

“Seek? No, my luck is great so it is mine already.” He glared at Li Qiye: “After I become an immortal, you will prosper due to my greatness as well. There will be a place for you anywhere in Heaven Realm, so what are you waiting for?”

“I can sell promises too.” Li Qiye smiled: “Follow me and work hard, I’ll give you half of Dusk Realm.”

“Brat, you sure have a big mouth.” He was amused by Li Qiye’s limited knowledge of the cultivation world.

“That’s fine if you refuse.” Li Qiye said.

“Forget it, I’ll take you in there and broaden your horizon. Let’s see if you can gain anything out of it.” He laughed and patted Li Qiye’s shoulder.

“So how will you cross Omen Path?” Li Qiye asked.

“Brat, let me tell you something, it is essential to know our place and limits. You have to be grounded and not blindly ambitious.” He turned red and said.

“Keeping my feet grounded doesn’t help with getting through Omen Path.” Li Qiye said.

“Haha, we’ll get someone to take us.” He smirked.

As Li Qiye was surprised by the answer, he pulled the arm of an immortal passing by and begged: “Immortal, please take me too?”

The immortal pushed him away and entered Omen Path.

“Immortal, you’re from Amethyst Alliance? Me too.” He saw another immortal approaching.

“Yes?” The immortal stopped.

“I am a member of Amethyst as well, please look at my badge.” He presented his badge: “Could you take us with you to see Dusk Realm?”

“You two?” The immortal only wanted to take Mo Xiangsheng.

“Please, we wish to broaden our horizon.” He pulled Li Qiye closer.

“A mortal can’t make it.” The immortal said.

“Haha, you can make it happen, given your great power.” He smiled.

“I can take you along since we’re from the same alliance, but not the mortal.” The immortal shook his head.
